pages.text: Northstar adds three metals: Titanium, Tungsten and Martian Steel. Titanium is the base of most of the tech. Ore for it sits on all four worlds, but you can also make it on Earth.

pages.title: Titanium Ingot
pages.text: Smelt or blast titanium ore from the Moon, Mars, Mercury or Venus. Also pressed into Titanium Sheets.

Rutile Concentrate is mixed superheated with zinc, chlorine and carbon into Titanium Tetrachloride. That is applied to a Sturdy Sheet in a sequenced assembly, with lava, to give a Titanium Ingot. Chlorine comes from electrolysing Brine.
pages.title: Titanium on Earth
Rutile Concentrate
pages.text: Crush sand, Create's limestone (best of the two) or Venus Gravel.

pages.title: Salt
pages.text: Northstar's brine chain makes salt. In this pack it is Create Ratatouille's Salt: brine compacts down to it, and Mars Gravel and Basalt crush into it. Other mods' salt converts 1:1 in a crafting grid.

pages.title: Tungsten Ingot
pages.text: Only from Mercury ore. The top tier of heat shielding.

pages.title: Martian Steel Ingot
pages.text: Heated compacting of Titanium, Raw Martian Iron and Volcanic Ash gives two ingots.

pages.title: Circuit
pages.text: Made by sequenced assembly. Used in rockets, oxygen gear and most space machines.
